main_failure_modes: The root-cause finding was labeled anchoring_bias instead of Fundamental Attribution Bias and did not fully capture dispositional attribution.
The alignment finding was labeled overconfidence_bias instead of Illusion of control, despite correctly describing the personal-control mechanism.
Moderate-confidence findings were required to achieve complete segment coverage.
main_strengths: All findings were localized to the correct decision episodes with valid interview quotations.
Gambler's Fallacy and Ambiguity effect were identified with high confidence and full mechanisms.
The RAG accurately disclosed that retrieved corpus support was unavailable.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run has perfect segment detection but only 0.5 strict instance-level F1. Mechanism-first scoring raises instance-level F1 to 0.75, indicating a meaningful taxonomy gap caused by two near-neighbor labels rather than localization or evidence-fidelity failures.
